kg.node.mc_block_to_item.tooltip: Converts a block to its corresponding item.
kg.node.mc_item_to_block.tooltip: Converts a block item to its block when possible.
kg.node.mc_item_stack_create.tooltip: Creates an ItemStack from an item and count.
kg.node.mc_item_in_tag.tooltip: Checks whether an item belongs to a Minecraft item tag.
kg.node.mc_direction_axis.tooltip: Reads the axis of a direction.
kg.node.mc_block_pos_create.tooltip: Creates a BlockPos from x, y, and z coordinates.
kg.node.mc_block_pos_offset.tooltip: Offsets a BlockPos by a direction and distance.
kg.node.mc_get_block.tooltip: Reads the block at a position in a level.
kg.node.mc_get_block_state.tooltip: Reads the block state at a position in a level.
kg.node.mc_get_block_entity.tooltip: Reads the block entity at a position in a level.
kg.node.mc_is_empty_block.tooltip: Checks whether a level position is empty air.
kg.node.mc_entity_distance.tooltip: Computes the distance between two entities.
kg.node.mc_entities_in_radius.tooltip: Finds entities around a center position within a radius.
kg.node.mc_entities_in_aabb.tooltip: Finds entities inside an axis-aligned box.
kg.node.mc_nbt_get.tooltip: Reads a typed value from a CompoundTag by key.
kg.node.mc_nbt_set.tooltip: Writes a typed value into a CompoundTag by key.
kg.node.mc_nbt_remove.tooltip: Removes a key from a CompoundTag.
kg.node.mc_nbt_has.tooltip: Checks whether a CompoundTag contains a key.
kg.node.mc_nbt_item_stack.tooltip: Reads the NBT data stored on an ItemStack.
kg.node.mc_nbt_block_entity.tooltip: Reads the NBT data stored on a BlockEntity.
kg.node.info_block_pos.tooltip: Groups readable BlockPos properties as info blocks.
kg.node.info_block_state.tooltip: Groups readable BlockState properties as info blocks.
kg.node.info_direction.tooltip: Groups readable Direction properties as info blocks.
kg.node.info_entity.tooltip: Groups readable Entity properties as info blocks.
kg.node.info_fluid_stack.tooltip: Groups readable FluidStack properties as info blocks.
kg.node.info_item_stack.tooltip: Groups readable ItemStack properties as info blocks.
kg.node.info_level.tooltip: Groups readable Level properties as info blocks.
kg.node.info_player.tooltip: Groups readable Player properties as info blocks.
kg.node.info_field.tooltip: Reads one selected property from the parent info target.
kg.node.rt_vertex_model_position.tooltip: The model-space vertex position; the standard Minecraft transform (ProjMat · ModelViewMat) is applied after. Unconnected = the mesh position, untouched.
kg.node.rt_vertex_model_normal.tooltip: The model-space normal, replacing the mesh Normal for lighting, Fresnel defaults and the Normal node. Unconnected = the mesh normal, untouched.
kg.node.rt_vertex_position.tooltip: Advanced: writes the final clip-space vertex position directly.
kg.node.rt_vertex_custom_float.tooltip: Passes a custom float varying from vertex to fragment.
kg.node.rt_vertex_custom_vec2.tooltip: Passes a custom vec2 varying from vertex to fragment.
kg.node.rt_vertex_custom_vec3.tooltip: Passes a custom vec3 varying from vertex to fragment.
kg.node.rt_vertex_custom_vec4.tooltip: Passes a custom vec4 varying from vertex to fragment.
kg.node.rt_fragment_base_color.tooltip: Writes the fragment base color output.
kg.node.rt_fragment_alpha_discard.toolti: Discards fragments below an alpha threshold.
kg.node.rt_in_vertex_attribute.tooltip: Reads a raw vertex attribute from the current vertex format.
kg.node.rt_uv.tooltip: Outputs a mesh UV channel. Usable in both the vertex and fragment stages.
kg.node.rt_vertex_color.tooltip: Outputs the mesh vertex color with the selected lighting mode. Usable in both the vertex and fragment stages.
kg.node.rt_view_direction.tooltip: Outputs the unnormalized direction from the surface to the camera (length = distance to camera) in the selected space.
kg.node.rt_position.tooltip: Outputs the mesh surface position in the selected space (Object/World/View). Usable in both the vertex and fragment stages. Each space is defined by the render pipeline — a pipeline whose vertices carry no object space maps Object to World.
kg.node.rt_normal.tooltip: Outputs the mesh surface normal in the selected space (Object/World/View). Usable in both the vertex and fragment stages. Each space is defined by the render pipeline — a pipeline whose vertices carry no object space maps Object to World.
kg.node.rt_vertex_id.tooltip: Outputs gl_VertexID. Usable in both stages — auto-forwarded to the fragment stage as a flat varying.
kg.node.rt_instance_id.tooltip: Outputs gl_InstanceID. Usable in both stages — auto-forwarded to the fragment stage as a flat varying.
kg.node.rt_front_facing.tooltip: Outputs whether the current fragment is front-facing.
kg.node.rt_fragment_coord.tooltip: Outputs the current fragment window coordinate.
kg.node.rt_primitive_id.tooltip: Outputs the current primitive ID when available.
kg.node.rt_frag_spherical_distance.toolt: Outputs the interpolated spherical fog distance.
kg.node.rt_frag_cylindrical_distance.too: Outputs the interpolated cylindrical fog distance.
kg.node.rt_texture.tooltip: Defines a texture sampler source for texture sampling nodes.
kg.node.rt_sampler_texture2d.tooltip: Samples a Texture2D sampler at UV coordinates.
kg.node.rt_gradient.tooltip: A constant gradient (color keys + alpha keys, Blend/Fixed). Feed it into a Sample Gradient node.
kg.node.rt_sample_gradient.tooltip: Samples a Gradient at Time (0-1) to a color. An unconnected Time defaults to the mesh UV.x, so the preview shows the gradient swept horizontally.
kg.node.rt_curve.tooltip: A constant float curve (bezier keys remapped to [lower, upper]). Feed it into a Sample Curve node. For a runtime-adjustable curve, expose a Curve variable instead.
kg.node.rt_sample_curve.tooltip: Samples a Curve at Time (0-1) to a float in the curve's [lower, upper] range. An unconnected Time defaults to the mesh UV.x, so the preview shows the curve swept horizontally.
kg.node.rt_screen_position.tooltip: Outputs the fragment screen position in the selected coordinate space.
kg.node.rt_screen.tooltip: Outputs screen size and related screen parameters.
kg.node.rt_scene_color.tooltip: Samples the captured scene color buffer.
kg.node.rt_scene_depth.tooltip: Samples the captured scene depth buffer.
kg.node.rt_camera.tooltip: Outputs camera position and camera-space data.
kg.node.rt_dynamic_transforms_ubo.toolti: Exposes Minecraft dynamic transform uniform values.
kg.node.rt_projection_from_position.tool: Projects a position into clip or screen space.
kg.node.rt_transform.tooltip: Converts a vector between object, view, world, clip, and screen spaces.
kg.node.rt_globals_ubo.tooltip: Exposes Minecraft global uniform values (camera block pos/offset, screen size, glint alpha, game time, menu blur radius, RGSS flag).
kg.node.rt_lighting_ubo.tooltip: Exposes Minecraft lighting direction uniform values (the two directional light vectors).
kg.node.rt_apply_fog.tooltip: Applies Minecraft-style fog to an input color.
kg.node.rt_fog_spherical_distance.toolti: Outputs spherical fog distance for the fragment.
kg.node.rt_fog_cylindrical_distance.tool: Outputs cylindrical fog distance for the fragment.
kg.node.rt_linear_fog_value.tooltip: Computes a linear fog factor from distance and range.
kg.node.rt_total_fog_value.tooltip: Combines fog inputs into the final fog amount.
kg.node.rt_tiling_offset.tooltip: Applies tiling and offset to UV coordinates.
kg.node.rt_rotate.tooltip: Rotates UV coordinates around a center.
kg.node.rt_twirl.tooltip: Twists UV coordinates around a center.
kg.node.rt_spherize.tooltip: Warps UV coordinates toward a spherical shape.
kg.node.rt_radial_shear.tooltip: Applies radial shear to UV coordinates.
kg.node.rt_polar_coordinates.tooltip: Converts UV coordinates to polar coordinates.
kg.node.rt_flipbook.tooltip: Selects a frame from a tiled flipbook texture.
kg.node.rt_triplanar.tooltip: Samples a texture using triplanar projection.
kg.node.rt_channel_mixer.tooltip: Remaps RGB channels using per-channel weights.
kg.node.rt_replace_color.tooltip: Replaces colors near a target color.
kg.node.rt_blend.tooltip: Blends two colors with a Photoshop-style blend mode.
kg.node.rt_channel_mask.tooltip: Builds a mask from selected channels.
kg.node.rt_color_mask.tooltip: Builds a mask from distance to a target color.
kg.node.rt_normal_from_height.tooltip: Builds a normal from a height field.
kg.node.rt_normal_from_texture.tooltip: Samples and unpacks a normal texture.
kg.node.rt_normal_reconstruct_z.tooltip: Reconstructs the z component of a normal.
kg.node.rt_normal_unpack.tooltip: Unpacks a texture color into a normal vector.
kg.node.rt_colorspace_conversion.tooltip: Converts color values between RGB, linear, and HSV spaces.
kg.node.rt_expression.tooltip: Runs a user-authored GLSL function with custom ports.
kg.node.rt_branch.tooltip: Selects between two values based on a boolean condition.
kg.node.rt_compare.tooltip: Compares two values with the selected comparison operation.
kg.node.rt_screen_position.option.mode.t: Raw: homogeneous screen position; divide xy by w to get UV.
Center: screen position remapped to -1..1 around the center.
Tiled: centered, aspect-corrected, and repeated with fract.
Pixel: screen position in pixel coordinates.
kg.node.rt_scene_depth.option.sampling.t: Linear 01: linear depth from near 0 to far 1.
Eye: camera-space distance in world units.
kg.node.rt_vertex_color.option.mode.tool: Mix Light: vanilla diffuse lighting using color and normal attributes.
Block: vertex color multiplied by the lightmap sample.
kg.node.rt_transform.option.from.tooltip: Source coordinate space for the input vector.
kg.node.rt_transform.option.to.tooltip: Target coordinate space; Screen performs perspective divide to screen coordinates.
kg.node.rt_transform.option.type.tooltip: Position includes translation; Direction ignores translation; Normal also normalizes.
kg.node.rt_blend.option.mode.tooltip: Blend formula used to combine Base and Blend before opacity is applied.
kg.node.rt_uv.option.channel.tooltip: UV0 is texture UV; UV1 and UV2 are Minecraft overlay and lightmap coordinates.
kg.node.rt_view_direction.option.space.t: Coordinate space of the view direction: World, Object, or View. Tangent is unavailable (Minecraft meshes have no per-vertex tangent basis).
kg.node.rt_view_direction.option.normali: Normalize the output to a unit-length direction. Off by default — the raw vector's length is the distance to the camera.
kg.node.rt_position.option.space.tooltip: Coordinate space of the position: World (absolute), Object, or View. Tangent is unavailable (Minecraft meshes have no per-vertex tangent basis).
kg.node.rt_normal.option.space.tooltip: Coordinate space of the normal: World, Object, or View. Tangent is unavailable (Minecraft meshes have no per-vertex tangent basis).
kg.node.rt_in_vertex_attribute.option.at: Vertex-format element to read; the graph warns if the format does not include it.
kg.node.rt_texture.option.texture.toolti: Texture asset and sampler settings baked into the material sampler.
JSON-backed custom GLSL function spec: ports plus function body.
